name: canvas
description: Read local Canvas projects and create or export assistant packages through the running desktop app.

interface.longDescription: Explore open Canvas projects, node text previews, connections, and available agent definitions. Create an assistant from instructions and skills, save it to Canvas's local user assistant folder, and export installed assistants as .flowast packages. Canvas must be running on the same Windows computer with MCP enabled at its fixed local endpoint. Assistant creation and export write package files; project access remains read-only. The connection cannot edit projects, execute assistants, generate media, or return original asset files. No manual client configuration is required.
